ClawBell is a reusable public-safe website chat for operators who want a narrow public agent surface without exposing their private workspace.

Start here:
- README.md: public product overview, trust boundary, quickstart, docs map
- AGENTS.md: repo rules and coding-agent safety boundary
- INSTALL_FOR_AGENTS.md: setup flow and bridge choice
- CLAWBELL_VERIFY.md: post-deploy smoke tests

Important constraints:
- Canonical repo is https://github.com/kenseals/clawbell
- This repo is generic product docs, not Ken's personal-site config
- Public ClawBell must call only a narrow authenticated bridge, never a full OpenClaw gateway
- Visitors are never trusted as operator/admin

Useful files:
- bridge-recipes/cloudflare-tunnel.md
- bridge-recipes/tailscale-funnel.md
- bridge-recipes/custom-https-bridge.md
- server.mjs
- scripts/local-openclaw-bridge.mjs
- scripts/operator-digest.mjs
